Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: A barbershop appointment booked by a customer at Abo Al-Ata Salon.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this booking.

customerName.description: Full or first name of the customer.

customerPhone.description: Egyptian mobile number (+20) used for WhatsApp/SMS confirmation and reminders.

barberName.description: Display name of the selected barber (e.g. مودي, صنايعي 2, صنايعي 3).

packageId.description: Identifier of the chosen grooming package (no prices).

packageTitle.description: Arabic title of the selected grooming package.

packageServices.description: Summary of services included in the selected package.

selectedHaircut.description: Optional global haircut name chosen from the catalog.

appointmentDate.description: Arabic formatted date string (e.g. اليوم (الإثنين) ١٦ نوفمبر).

appointmentTime.description: Arabic formatted display time slot (e.g. 11:30 مساءً).

appointmentEpochMillis.description: Appointment start timestamp in epoch milliseconds used for Today's Bookings filtering and 30-min reminders.

notes.description: Optional special requests or notes from the customer.

reminderScheduled.description: Whether a 30-minute prior local reminder WorkManager job/notification is scheduled.

rating.description: Optional 1-5 star customer rating submitted after a completed appointment (0 when unrated).

feedbackComment.description: Optional customer review comment submitted after a completed appointment.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SalonPreference.title: SalonPreference
SalonPreference.description: Per-user saved customer contact info and optional barber display name customizations.

savedCustomerName.description: Default customer name pre-filled during booking.

savedPhone.description: Default customer phone number pre-filled during booking.

barber2CustomName.description: Optional custom label for Barber 2 (empty defaults to صنايعي 2).

barber3CustomName.description: Optional custom label for Barber 3 (empty defaults to صنايعي 3).

salonWhatsappPhone.description: Salon contact and WhatsApp phone number (defaults to 01029898309).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/appointments/{appointmen.description: User-isolated appointments containing customer phone number, barber selection, package, catalog haircut, and reminder status.

/salon_bookings/{appointmentId}.description: Central salon schedule collection strictly restricted to the verified Salon Owner for viewing Today's Bookings across all customers, while preserving per-user write ownership.

/users/{userId}/salon_preferences/{prefI.description: User-isolated profile preferences and salon contact configuration.
